title: IVG Intense Salts Triple Mango 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Triple Mango layers three distinct Mango notes into one tropical blend. Juicy and sun-ripened, the flavour balances sweetness with a touch of tang for a fruity, satisfying vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid provides consistent flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Triple Mango is best enjoyed in mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, vape pens and starter devices. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Triple Mango celebrates a favourite tropical fruit in a flavour-packed format.
